reproduction_scope: Existing fixture delay after collector entry; worker DEAD_LETTERED and missing SSL marker. Terminal error was not captured by these old-fixture probes.
diagnosis: A legitimate pre-SSL deadline can finish the worker without entering the real SSL factory. The old fixture unconditionally indexed its absent marker.
hosted_cause_limit: The exact hosted delay is not proven; deterministic same-mechanism reproduction is not a claim to have measured it.
product_relation: Test, adapter, transport, worker and collector prefix through adapter.search are unchanged from base; new aggregator identity handling occurs later.
new_verification: source-execution.json and source-tests.xml retain separate cold-accounting and real pre-SSL timeout oracles.
